title: The Judge's Rationale: Sirius XM Cleared in AI Hiring-Discrimination Lawsuit
key_facts: A federal judge in Detroit dismissed a class-action lawsuit alleging Sirius XM Radio used algorithmic tools to make hiring decisions that discriminated against Black applicants.
The court found that a large number of rejected applications, and zip code used as a proxy for race, were not sufficient to show race discrimination or disparate impact discrimination.
Disparate impact means discrimination by unequal effect on a group, even without intent (explanatory term, not a quote).
Law.com says the ruling could be instructive as interest in algorithms in hiring grows.
The ruling date is not stated in the text read; the article is dated 7 Oct 2026.
